business_problem: CreativeFitting needed to accelerate iteration of its self-developed AIGC video-generation models, eliminate manual compute scheduling and duplicate training-data distribution, balance daily GPU demand spikes against cost control, and support localized content creation for global markets.
solution_summary: CreativeFitting used Huawei Cloud to turn its self-developed AIGC video model into a scalable production system for advertising clips, short dramas, and localized content. Huawei Cloud GPU compute resources back the company's two-year video-model training effort, while a data flywheel feeds the model with real business feedback and curated annotation data so algorithm engineers can iterate and redeploy quickly. For production, CreativeFitting built an AI-assisted content pipeline that uses multimodal generative AI tools for characters, scenes, voiceovers, and scripts, then runs those workloads on elastic GPU clusters built with Huawei Cloud Elastic Cloud Server (ECS) and Cloud Container Engine (CCE) so capacity can expand and contract with daily demand peaks. The company also combines its domain expertise with large language models to support cross-language, cross-culture localization for creators in multiple regions.

solution_components.name: Huawei Cloud GPU compute resources
solution_components.role: Provide the accelerated training capacity used to iterate CreativeFitting's self-developed video-generation models.

solution_components.name: Elastic Cloud Server (ECS)
solution_components.role: Supplies elastic compute capacity for AI-assisted content production during demand peaks and troughs.

solution_components.name: Cloud Container Engine (CCE)
solution_components.role: Orchestrates the GPU production clusters that run CreativeFitting's multimodal content-generation pipeline.

data_flow: Real business feedback and labeled training data are fed back into CreativeFitting's video model on Huawei Cloud GPU compute. The updated models are then deployed onto ECS and CCE-based GPU clusters, where multimodal tools generate characters, scenes, voiceovers, and scripts that can be localized with large language models for global creators.
business_outcome: CreativeFitting increased average daily content output by nearly 10x, achieved script quality where more than 70% of AI-generated scripts were judged to have been written by local experts, and reduced the operating burden of scaling its AI-assisted production pipeline.

GPU demand shows strong peak-and-valley behavior across the day, so the company designed elastic GPU scheduling.
Large language models are used to localize content across languages and cultures.
The company was an early startup participant in the Huawei Cloud Pangu large-model ecosystem.
